title: A Escarpment for the Rivergate
author: F. M. Brightwater
blurb: Ines Halloran, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
